assessment: This important study represents a data processing pipeline to discover causal interactions from time-lapse imaging data and convincingly illustrates it on a challenging application for the analysis of tumor-on-chip ecosystem data. The authors describe the raw data they used (imaging data), go through a step-by-step description of how to extract the features they are interested in from the raw data, and how to perform the causal discovery process. This article tackles the problem of learning causal interactions from temporal data, which is applicable to many biological applications.
